description: Karnataka launches AI surveillance to enhance prison security, ensuring strict monitoring and management across all facilities statewide.
body_lead: Karnataka Home Minister G. Parameshwara on Saturday inaugurated a Central Command Centre for prisons in the State, a step towards foolproof security checks in State prisons. The initiative is part of a comprehensive, technology-driven surveillance and management plan rolled out by the Karnataka government to strengthen prison security and monitoring. The plan focuses on enhanced inmate monitoring, crowd control, and tracking staff movements through advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and checks any untoward incidents in the prisons across the State, Mr.
